title: Assessing Bias in Metric Models for LLM Open-Ended Generation Bias Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Creating counterfactual sentences by prepending gender descriptors (Males, Females, Non-binaries) to stereotype sentences and evaluating classifier prediction variations (sentiment, toxicity) using metric models and SHAP.

Creating counterfactual sentences by prepending profession descriptors (Construction workers, Bankers, Doctors, Nurses, Teachers) to stereotype sentences and evaluating classifier prediction variations using metric models and SHAP.
Creating counterfactual sentences by prepending racial descriptors (Whites, Blacks, Asians) to stereotype sentences and evaluating classifier prediction variations using metric models and SHAP.

Creating counterfactual sentences by prepending religious descriptors (Atheists, Christians, Jews, Muslims) to stereotype sentences and evaluating classifier prediction variations using metric models and SHAP.
